lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Primary lines exhibit significant fading and pixel discontinuity as they approach the ventral region, with the third and fourth lines terminating into isolated pixel clusters before reaching the lower torso boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A dense grouping of approximately 7-9 high-contrast white spots is located on the posterior flank, immediately superior to the hind limb joint.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A distinct horizontal alignment of three spots forms a semi-linear geometric pattern across the upper posterior thigh.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns exhibit a spiral lyrate curvature, angling posteriorly from the frontal bone before curving laterally and then medially toward the apex.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The estimated pixel distance between the horn tips is approximately 1.75 times the width of the external horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping occupies approximately 10-15% of the total visible vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Bright white crescent patch visible on the ventral neck; distinct tan/ochre pigmentation on all four limbs below the carpal/tarsal joints; two high-contrast white spots present on the lateral mandibular region.
